calculation_boundary.calendar_rule: Intersect accepted complete observation dates under each required input's declared calendar and gap policy; never fill, zero, relabel, or use a future observation.

as_of_policy.publication_lag_rule: Cadence, maximum age, and publication lag determine warning telemetry and limiting-input disclosure; age alone does not invalidate a complete historical calculation or require a development refresh.

corrections.disposition_reason: History existence is not capture. The uncaptured provider report remains comparison evidence and cannot become owner account-live or hybrid backtest input.
Product NAV before the proved held observation is provider-live comparison evidence. It is never relabeled as owner account-live.
Funding becomes effective on the first confirmed held observation. The boundary return is excluded; measurable account-live returns begin the following day.

The governed generation contains one hash-bound live/simulation twin and a reproducible model-return candidate. The current product version and compatibility remain unresolved, so the candidate is retained as evidence but cannot enter LIVE_ONLY or LIVE_PLUS_BACKTEST.
The exact provider-live model is captured, but the exact-version backtest is not. Other European books are different models and cannot be substituted.

The exact provider-managed Strategy performance level is captured and a deterministic candidate P123_MANAGED_STRATEGY_PERFORMANCE_LEVEL_TO_RETURN_V1 is reproducible. Cash Added reconciles to the equity curve but its financial interpretation is not approved and is not used in the candidate return formula. No provider-live return is admitted; #303 must admit or declare the transform while preserving separation from the IBKR owner account-live path.
Owner funding precedes the first measurable account return by one day. Provider-live history remains a separate comparison and never overwrites this path.
The current price path is provider/account live, not a backtest. A hybrid backtest remains unavailable until exact-version evidence is captured.
The two provider curves are equality evidence for one economic path. They are not duplicate return series and are not relabeled as backtest.

The earlier purchase does not establish funded membership without an accepted event-time value. Membership begins with the first capital-reconciled positive NAV and cost basis; measurable account returns begin the following day.

The captured rows occur only on transaction/fill dates and reproduce the event-to-event sparse-pool formula using last-trade marks. They are retained as rejected evidence, not admitted as daily account-live returns.
